$comment: Reviewed packages whose licence is not in ADR 0011's permissive tier; checked by scripts/licences.ts. Each entry records the exact licence, so a licence change upstream needs a new review.

axe-core.reason: Accessibility test engine, unmodified; runs only in the Playwright tests and is never bundled into the frontend.

@axe-core/playwright.reason: Playwright binding of axe-core, unmodified; test-only, never bundled.

lightningcss.reason: CSS transformer that Vite runs at build time, unmodified; its code is not bundled into the frontend.

lightningcss-*.reason: Platform-specific native binaries of lightningcss, unmodified, loaded by it at build time.
